title: Auto item picker
features: picks up items for yba reborn
script:
-- \\ main toggle
getgenv().itempicker = true

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Root = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local ItemsFolder = Workspace.Item_Spawns.Items

if not ItemsFolder then
    warn("Items folder not found!")
end

local TweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(
    0.5,
    Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
    Enum.EasingDirection.Out
)

local function moveTo(targetCFrame)
    if not targetCFrame then
        warn("moveTo: Invalid CFrame provided")
        return
    end

    local Goal = { CFrame = targetCFrame }
    local Tween = TweenService:Create(Root, TweenInfo, Goal)
    Tween:Play()
    Tween.Completed:Wait()
end

spawn(function()
    while true do
        if getgenv().itempicker and ItemsFolder then
            for _, Item in ipairs(ItemsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if getgenv().itempicker then
                    if Item:IsA("Model") then
                        local cframe

                        if Item.PrimaryPart then
                            cframe = Item.PrimaryPart.CFrame
                        else
                            local part = Item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Part")
                            if part then
                                cframe = part.CFrame
                            end
                        end

                        if cframe then
                            moveTo(cframe)
                            task.wait(0.25)

                            local clickDetector = Item:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
                            if clickDetector then
                                fireclickdetector(clickDetector, 4)
                                print("item clicked: ", Item.Name)
                            else
                                warn("no ClickDetector foud for item", Item.Name)
                            end

                            task.wait(1)
                        else
                            warn("no pos foud for item", Item.Name)
                        end

                    elseif Item:IsA("Part") then
                        moveTo(Item.CFrame)
                        task.wait(0.25)

                        local clickDetector = Item:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
                        if clickDetector then
                            fireclickdetector(clickDetector, 4)
                            print("item clicked: ", Item.Name)
                        else
                            warn("no ClickDetector foud for item:", Item.Name)
                        end

                        task.wait(1)
                    else
                        warn("error, object: ", Item.Name)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        task.wait()
    end
end)
